parsed.summary: The PR addresses the deprecation warning issue but introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the converter for empty data.

issues.description: The change introduces a non-minimal modification by handling empty data separately, which may not be the intended approach and could lead to unexpected behavior in other scenarios.
